team_lead.append:
## Provider-Specific Instructions

You CAN spawn experts as subagents using the Agent tool. When you need domain-specific answers, spawn the relevant expert from your roster — do not answer technical questions from general knowledge.

Prefer team-scoped expert variants (e.g., `expert-{name}_{team}`) when available — they have team context baked in.

Use `run_in_background: true` for expert consultations so you stay free to continue working.

project_lead.append:
## Provider-Specific Instructions

You CAN spawn team leads and experts as subagents using the Agent tool. When scoping work, you can directly consult team leads to understand which experts should be involved.

Use `run_in_background: true` for consultations so you stay free to continue working.
